Species to be used for parental species analysis
```{r}
STR7_parents=All_STR7_sp
STR7_parents$strpop<-rep("hybrid",693)
STR7_parents$pure<-rep(FALSE,693)
samples_detailed<-read.csv("../../00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_DATA/metadata_specimensSequenced_Duke_taxonomyfixed.csv")
taxa_update<-cbind(Seq=samples_detailed$Seq,Taxa=samples_detailed$species_epithet)
STR7_parents<-merge(STR7_parents,taxa_update, by.x="Sample",by.y="Seq")
for(i in 1:693){
    if(STR7_parents[i,4]>.99){
      STR7_parents[i,13]<-"alba"
      STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
    }else{
      if(STR7_parents[i,7]>.99){
        STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qlyr_Qbic"
        STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
        if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="lyrata"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="bicolor"){
         STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
        }
      }else{
       if(STR7_parents[i,2]>.99){
        STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qmic_Qmon"
        STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
        if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="michauxii"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="montana"){

          STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
          }
        }else{
            if(STR7_parents[i,5]>.99){
              STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qste_Qmar_Qsin"
              STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
              if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="stellata"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="margaretiae"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="sinuata"){
                STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
              }
            }else{
              if(STR7_parents[i,8]>.99){
                STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qmue_Qpri"
                STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
                if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="muehlenbergii"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="prinoides"){
                  STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
                }
              }else{
                if(STR7_parents[i,3]+STR7_parents[i,6]>0.99){
                  STR7_parents[i,13]<-"macrocarpa"
                  STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }


write.csv(STR7_parents,"../../STR7_99Parents.csv")
```

##PCA with outgroup
```{r}
library(adegenet)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
cbbPalette2.5=c("orange","#332288","#44AA99","#AA4499","#DDCC77","#000000","#88CCEE","#882255","#114433","#999933","#661100","#CC6677","#888888","red","blue","pink")
snp <- fasta2genlight(file="../chr1_thin.fa")
meta<-read.csv("../../00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_METADATA/metadata_specimensSequenced_Duke_taxonomyfixed.csv")
pca <- glPca(snp, nf=10)
qbarplot(pca$eig/sum(pca$eig))
pca.dataset = as.data.frame(pca$scores)
pca.dataset$isolates = rownames(pca.dataset)
#pca.dataset$pop = as.factor(meta[match(snp$ind.names, meta$ALTERNATE.PROJECTCODE),]$Site)
```

```{r}
Chr1_OutS10<-read.delim("../chr1_filter1.10.Q",sep = " ", header=FALSE)
C1_outgroup_PCA_sampling <- read.csv("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/02_STRUCTURE/C1_outgroup_PCA_sampling.csv", header=FALSE)

Chr1_OutS10$Sample<-C1_outgroup_PCA_sampling$V1
Chr1_OutS10$Sp<-C1_outgroup_PCA_sampling$V2


Chr1_OutS10$strpop<-rep("species",727)
#Chr1_OutS10$sp_cor<-rep(FALSE,693)
#Chr1_OutS10$hybrid<-rep("species",693)
for(i in 1:727){
  if(Chr1_OutS10[i,12]=="Quercus sinuata Walt." | Chr1_OutS10[i,12]=="rubra"){
  }else{
    if(Chr1_OutS10[i,1]+Chr1_OutS10[i,10]+Chr1_OutS10[i,7]>.90){
    }else{
      if(max(Chr1_OutS10[i,1:10])<.90){
       Chr1_OutS10[i,13]<-"hybrid"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
dat_bic_mac<-Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[(Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,12]=="Quercus macrocarpa Michx."|Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,12]=="Quercus bicolor Willd.")&(Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,3]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,4]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,5]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,7]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,6]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,10]<0.05),]
Pop_file<-read.csv("../../00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_METADATA/Seq_Pop_Coord.csv")
dat_bic_mac_pop<-merge(dat_bic_mac,Pop_file,by.x="Sample",by.y="Seq")
dat_bic_mac_pop$nSamps<-rep(1,361)
dat_bic_mac_pop$hybrids<-rep(0,361)
dat_bic_mac_pop$mac<-rep(0,361)
dat_bic_mac_pop$bic<-rep(0,361)
for(i in 1:361){
  if(dat_bic_mac_pop[i,13] == "hybrid"){
  dat_bic_mac_pop[i,35]<-1
  }
  if(dat_bic_mac_pop[i,12] == "Quercus macrocarpa Michx."){
  dat_bic_mac_pop[i,36]<-1
  }
  if(dat_bic_mac_pop[i,12] == "Quercus bicolor Willd."){
  dat_bic_mac_pop[i,37]<-1
  }
}
pop_stats_sum<-aggregate(x = dat_bic_mac_pop[,34:37],by=list(dat_bic_mac_pop$site),FUN="sum")
pop_stats_mean<-aggregate(x = dat_bic_mac_pop[,23],by=list(dat_bic_mac_pop$site,dat_bic_mac_pop$V2.y),FUN="mean")
pop_stats_mean2<-aggregate(x = dat_bic_mac_pop[,32:33],by=list(dat_bic_mac_pop$site),FUN="mean")
pop_stats<-merge(pop_stats_sum,pop_stats_mean,by="Group.1")
pop_stats<-merge(pop_stats,pop_stats_mean2,by="Group.1")

pop_stats_mac_bic<-pop_stats[pop_stats[,4]>0&pop_stats[,5]>0,]
pop_stats_mac_bic$p_hybrid<-pop_stats_mac_bic$hybrids/pop_stats_mac_bic$nSamps

ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(mapping=aes(x=pop_stats_mac_bic$Group.2,y=pop_stats_mac_bic$p_hybrid))+
  geom_jitter(mapping=aes(x=pop_stats_mac_bic$Group.2,y=pop_stats_mac_bic$p_hybrid),height = 0)+
  labs(x="time since glaciation (100,000 is Null)", y="percent of individuals hybridized", title = "Q. macrocarpa and Q. bicolor populations (10)" )+
  theme_light()

ggplot()+
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=pop_stats_mac_bic$x,y=pop_stats_mac_bic$p_hybrid,color=pop_stats_mac_bic$Group.2),size=2,alpha=.7)+
  labs(color="time since glaciation (100,000 is Null)", y="percent of individuals hybridized",x="distance to range edge", title = "Q. macrocarpa and Q. bicolor populations (10)" )+
  theme_light()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
dat_alb_bic<-Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[(Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,12]=="Quercus bicolor Willd."|Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,12]=="Quercus alba L.")&(Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,2]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,3]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,4]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,5]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,8]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,7]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,10]<0.05&Chr1_OutS10_bord_glac[,11]<0.05),]
Pop_file<-read.csv("../../00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_METADATA/Seq_Pop_Coord.csv")
dat_alb_bic_pop<-merge(dat_alb_bic,Pop_file,by.x="Sample",by.y="Seq")
dat_alb_bic_pop$nSamps<-rep(1,145)
dat_alb_bic_pop$hybrids<-rep(0,145)
dat_alb_bic_pop$bic<-rep(0,145)
dat_alb_bic_pop$alb<-rep(0,145)
for(i in 1:145){
  if(dat_alb_bic_pop[i,13] == "hybrid"){
  dat_alb_bic_pop[i,35]<-1
  }
  if(dat_alb_bic_pop[i,12] == "Quercus bicolor Willd."){
  dat_alb_bic_pop[i,36]<-1
  }
  if(dat_alb_bic_pop[i,12] == "Quercus alba L."){
  dat_alb_bic_pop[i,37]<-1
  }
}
pop_stats_sum<-aggregate(x = dat_alb_bic_pop[,34:37],by=list(dat_alb_bic_pop$site),FUN="sum")
pop_stats_mean<-aggregate(x = dat_alb_bic_pop[,23],by=list(dat_alb_bic_pop$site,dat_alb_bic_pop$V2.y),FUN="min")
pop_stats_mean2<-aggregate(x = dat_alb_bic_pop[,32:33],by=list(dat_alb_bic_pop$site),FUN="mean")
pop_stats<-merge(pop_stats_sum,pop_stats_mean,by="Group.1")
pop_stats<-merge(pop_stats,pop_stats_mean2,by="Group.1")

pop_stats_bic_alb<-pop_stats[pop_stats[,4]>0&pop_stats[,5]>0,]
pop_stats_bic_alb$p_hybrid<-pop_stats_bic_alb$hybrids/pop_stats_bic_alb$nSamps

ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(mapping=aes(x=pop_stats_bic_alb$Group.2,y=pop_stats_bic_alb$p_hybrid),outlier.size = 0,outlier.colour = "white")+
  geom_jitter(mapping=aes(x=pop_stats_bic_alb$Group.2,y=pop_stats_bic_alb$p_hybrid),height = 0)+
  labs(x="time since glaciation (100,000 is Null)", y="percent of individuals hybridized", title = "Q. bicolor and Q. alba populations (25)" )+
  theme_light()


ggplot()+
  geom_jitter(mapping=aes(x=pop_stats_bic_alb$x,y=pop_stats_bic_alb$p_hybrid,color=pop_stats_bic_alb$Group.2),size=2,alpha=.7)+
  labs(color="time since glaciation (100,000 is Null)", y="percent of individuals hybridized",x="distance to range edge", title = "Q. bicolor and Q. alba populations (25)" )+
  theme_light()

aov(pop_stats_bic_alb$p_hybrid~pop_stats_bic_alb$Group.2+pop_stats_bic_alb$x)
```

```{r}
All_S12_dat2=All_S12_dat
All_S12_dat2$strpop<-rep("hybrid",694)
#All_S12_dat2$sp_cor<-rep(FALSE,720)
All_S12_dat2$hybrid<-rep("hybrid60",694)
for(i in 1:694){
  if(All_S12_dat2[i,9]>.90){
    All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qste_Qmar"
    All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
  }else{
    if(All_S12_dat2[i,10]>.90){
      All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qalb"
      All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
    }else{
      if(All_S12_dat2[i,6]>.90){
        All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qlyr_Qbic"
        All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
      }else{
        if(All_S12_dat2[i,5]>.90){
          All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmic"
          All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
        }else{
            if(All_S12_dat2[i,3]>.90){
              All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmon"
              All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
            }else{
              if(All_S12_dat2[i,7]+All_S12_dat2[i,13]>.90){
                All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmue"
                All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
              }else{
                if(All_S12_dat2[i,4]>.90){
                  All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qsin"
                  All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
               }else{
                 if(All_S12_dat2[i,12]>.90){
                    All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qlob"
                    All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
                 }else{
                   if(All_S12_dat2[i,8]+All_S12_dat2[i,11]+All_S12_dat2[i,2]>0.90){
                     All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmac"
                     All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
                   }else{
                     if(All_S12_dat2[i,8]+All_S12_dat2[i,11]+All_S12_dat2[i,2]>0.60|All_S12_dat2[i,12]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,4]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,7]+All_S12_dat2[i,13]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,3]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,5]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,6]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,10]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,9]>.60){
                       All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"hybrid90"
                       
                     }
                   }

                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
write.csv(All_S12_dat2, "C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/02_STRUCTURE/S12_hyb.csv",row.names = FALSE)
```
